caption: The drawing depicts a single, light brown ankle-height boot, positioned upright and viewed from the side. The boot features a decorative scalloped edge along the top opening and a series of five buttons running vertically down the outer side, with corresponding button loops. The surface of the boot shows slight variations in shading to indicate contours and texture, but there are no visible patterns or additional elements on the boot itself. The background is an unadorned, off-white or beige color, and the drawing is centered on the page. Near the bottom right of the image, the name "M. Concha" is written in small, neat letters.
title: Baby Shoe
